# SOLIWAYS 2027 — Full AI-readable content

> SOLIWAYS 2027 is a four-day technology event in Tangier, Morocco, organized by SOLIWAYS and held at SOLICODE from 13 to 16 April 2027. It combines workshops, a forum, meetups, speaker talks and a web-development hackathon around web development, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, digital marketing and IT freelancing.

## Event facts

- Official name: SOLIWAYS 2027
- Edition: 2027
- Type: Technology event (workshops, talks, meetups, forum, hackathon)
- Start: 2027-04-13T09:00:00+01:00
- End: 2027-04-16T18:00:00+01:00
- Venue: SOLICODE, Tangier, Morocco
- City: Tangier (Tanger), Morocco
- Format: In-person
- Event status: Scheduled
- Audience: General public, students, beginners, technology enthusiasts, developers and freelancers
- Languages: French and English
- Organizer: SOLIWAYS
- Website: https://soli-ways.online/

## What is SOLIWAYS?

SOLIWAYS is the organizer and brand behind SOLIWAYS 2027, an event dedicated to computing, digital technologies and knowledge sharing. The event is designed as a space to learn, exchange experiences and practise digital skills.

The official website presents SOLIWAYS 2027 as an initiative built around IT, learning and the exchange of experiences, with several days of activities covering different areas of the digital world.

## Mission and vision

- Vision: make SOLIWAYS a meeting and discovery space around digital technologies.
- Approach: learn new IT topics, exchange ideas and experiences, and put knowledge into practice through workshops and a hackathon.
- Tagline: “La technologie au cœur de l’apprentissage et du partage.” (Technology at the heart of learning and sharing.)

## Programme

### 13 April 2027 — Opening and digital workshops

Official launch of SOLIWAYS 2027, welcome of participants, introduction to the event, and discovery of the main digital fields through introductory workshops.

### 14 April 2027 — In-depth themed workshops

- Web development and architecture
- Generative artificial intelligence and prompting techniques
- Cybersecurity and data protection
- Digital marketing and IT freelancing

### 15 April 2027 — Forum, meetups and speakers

A day for networking, project discovery and sharing experiences among technology enthusiasts, learners and professionals, with talks on artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

### 16 April 2027 — Web-development hackathon

A day dedicated to teamwork and building web prototypes in groups, with support from mentors and evaluation by a technical jury.

## Themes

- Web development: creating websites and web applications, and exploring modern digital development.
- Artificial intelligence and prompting: uses of AI and prompt-writing techniques for working effectively with AI tools.
- Cybersecurity: digital security challenges and protection of systems, networks and data.
- Digital marketing: digital communication channels and practices for building an online presence.
- Freelancing and IT entrepreneurship: independent work, client management and building a professional activity in the digital sector.

## Who can participate?

The event is open to the general public: high-school students, university students, curious beginners, technology enthusiasts, developers and freelancers who want to discover or deepen their digital skills. No specific prerequisite is stated on the official website.
